{"path":"neuron_growth_anthropic-claude-sonnet-5_01.html","edit_description":"
Create a complete, self-contained HTML file implementing an animated "neuron growth" neon network visualization. Requirements:

STRUCTURE:
- Single HTML file, DOCTYPE html, head with title "Neuron Growth Network", inline <style>, and inline <script> at the end. No external files except dat.gui loaded from a public CDN script tag (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js).
- Body has a dark background (#05070f) filling the viewport, flex-centered, containing one <canvas id="canvas" width="800" height="800"></canvas> styled with a subtle glowing border/box-shadow using #101a3a and #00e5ff, centered on the page.
- dat.GUI panel appears in its default top-right position (do not hide it).

COLOR PALETTE (use exactly, as JS config defaults and CSS where relevant):
- background: '#05070f'
- backgroundGlow: '#101a3a'
- branchColor: '#00e5ff'
- accentColor: '#d6ff00'
- synapseColor: '#ff2bd6'
- pulseColor: '#fff36a'
- uiColor: '#ffd400'
- gridColor: 'rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)'

GUI (dat.gui), organize into folders, all controls wired live to the simulation params object via onChange/onFinishChange where relevant, open by default:
- Growth folder: neuronCount (3-6 int, triggers regenerate on change), growthSpeed (0.1-5), maxDepth (2-10 int), splitChance (0-1), curvature (0-1), maxBranchLength (20-200)
- Synapses folder: synapseDistance (5-100), synapseGlow (0-40)
- Pulses folder: pulseSpeed (0.1-5), pulseFrequency (0-1), pulseBrightness (0-2)
- Visuals folder: background color picker, branchColor picker, accentColor picker, synapseColor picker, pulseColor picker (dat.gui addColor bound to hex string params, on change just update the param, rendering reads params live)
- Root-level or a folder for actions: three buttons wired to functions: "Regenerate Network" (rebuild seed neurons + reset branches/synapses/pulses), "Clear Canvas" (empty all branches/neurons/synapses/pulses, stop growth, canvas will just render background/vignette/scanlines), "Pause / Resume" (toggle an `isPaused` flag; when paused requestAnimationFrame loop keeps running but simulation update is skipped so rendering freezes, button label doesn't need to change dynamically but code should toggle a boolean cleanly)

SIMULATION LOGIC (vanilla JS, no classes required but fine to use them, keep compact and commented):
- On init/regenerate: create 3-6 (per neuronCount) seed neuron nodes at random positions within a radius of canvas center (e.g. within ~150px of (400,400)), each with a random initial angle.
- Each seed neuron owns 1-2 initial growing branch "tips". A branch tip is an object with: x, y, angle, depth, length-so-far, thickness, color (alternate between branchColor and accentColor with e.g. 80/20 probability), parentId, id, alive flag.
- Growth update runs on a timer/frame gated by growthSpeed: each alive tip advances a small step forward along its angle, angle gets a small random perturbation scaled by curvature to create organic wandering curves, segment endpoints are recorded into a `segments` array (each segment: x1,y1,x2,y2,color,thickness) used for quadratic-curve smoothed rendering (store a midpoint control point or simply use lineTo with slight smoothing via averaging consecutive points — keep lightweight).
- When a tip's accumulated length exceeds maxBranchLength/depth-scaled limit or randomly, it may terminate, or with splitChance probability spawn a new child tip (branching) at current point with a diverging angle, incrementing depth, only if depth < maxDepth.
- Cap total branch tips / total segments at a reasonable number (e.g. 400-600 segments) to keep performance stable — stop spawning new tips beyond the cap.
- Track all branch tip positions (growing and terminated endpoints). After each growth step, check pairwise distances between tip endpoints (and terminated tip endpoints) that belong to different neurons/branches; if distance < synapseDistance and no existing synapse already connects that pair (track connected pairs in a Set keyed by sorted ids to prevent duplicates), create a synapse object {a, b, x1,y1,x2,y2, phase (random)}.
- Once all tips are terminated (or after a max growth time), growth stops (`growthActive = false`); simulation then continuously spawns random pulses traveling along random existing synapses.
- Pulses: object {synapse, t (0..1 progress), speed}; update t += pulseSpeed*dt fraction each frame, remove when t>=1; new pulses spawn randomly among synapses at a rate controlled by pulseFrequency (probability per frame or interval).

RENDERING (in draw loop via requestAnimationFrame):
- Clear canvas each frame with background color, optionally fill a soft radial gradient using backgroundGlow color from center outward for atmosphere.
- Draw very faint scanlines (horizontal lines every few px) using gridColor with low alpha, and/or a faint subtle animated grid/noise pattern using canvas primitives only (no images) — keep it cheap (e.g. drawn to an offscreen pattern or simple loop with low opacity, updated occasionally not necessarily every frame).
- Draw all segments as glowing neon lines: set ctx.shadowBlur (e.g. 8-15) and ctx.shadowColor = segment color, ctx.strokeStyle = segment color, vary lineWidth slightly per segment thickness, use quadraticCurveTo or simple smoothing for organic look.
- Draw synapses as small glowing nodes/short connecting lines at their point using synapseColor, with shadowBlur driven by synapseGlow param, and a subtle pulsing brightness over time (e.g. sinusoidal based on Date.now() and synapse.phase).
- Draw pulses as small bright glowing dots (pulseColor) interpolated (lerp) along their synapse's line from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) based on t, with shadowBlur scaled by pulseBrightness param.
- Add a faint vignette: radial gradient from transparent center to darker/black edges drawn as an overlay each frame.
- All glow effects must use canvas shadowBlur/shadowColor only — no external image assets.
- Use requestAnimationFrame with delta-time based updates so animation speed is frame-rate independent-ish (compute dt from performance.now() differences, clamp it).

CODE STRUCTURE with clear section comments (English, no mention of any game/movie/brand/copyrighted style anywhere):
// ---- Setup ----
// ---- GUI Setup ----
// ---- Neuron / Branch Growth ----
// ---- Synapse Detection ----
// ---- Pulse Animation ----
// ---- Rendering ----
// ---- Main Loop ----
Keep everything in plain functions/objects operating on a shared `state` object holding params, neurons, segments, synapses, pulses, isPaused, growthActive flags. Keep the whole file reasonably compact but complete and functional as pure copy-pasteable HTML.
"}
